scope: 22 slab minion classes: declared method inventories, literal base getter values and selected combat/interaction/movement overrides. Not runtime combat or pathfinding certification.
limits: Base melee damage is an attribute input, not DPS or final health loss.
An absent subclass override means the selected base behavior, not a proof that no external mod can add abilities.
Effect durations and amplifiers are requests; immunity and other effect processing remain external.
Mecha Skellox custom travel is indexed as a distinct movement implementation, not certified flight or riding support.
